mhtext1: As a systems technician, I can manage and configure office tools and equipment, participate in setting up computer networks, and perform preventive computer maintenance. As a web developer, I also work with the technologies listed below.
pro1des: A robust and functional software system for restaurants, designed around the operation of five user roles: Unregistered Customer, Regular Customer, Waiter, Cashier, Head Chef, and Administrator.
pro2des: A subject-based grade management system that efficiently integrates the roles of student and teacher, with authentication based on session cookies. Statistics were incorporated for both the student and the teacher.
pro3des: Enhancement of the Moodle learning styles module through the incorporation of a custom dashboard, questionnaire redesign, and improved results panel. Chart.js was used for the charts.
pro4des: An interactive app designed to train young learners in math, featuring streak and point systems, sound effects, and mobile optimization.
pro5des: An app that simulates physical dice with realistic sound effects and fast action — a practical alternative to traditional dice.
